meta.name: Miya Biwi Aur Murder
meta.description:
Miya aur Biwi, Priya and Jayesh are struggling in a dysfunctional marriage of 7 years. 1 night, over the course of 7 hours, they will have to work together to stay alive. Can they do it? Or do they fall victim to the madness of the night.

Returning Series · First aired 1 Jul 2022 · India · Language: Hindi

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: While husband Jayesh is out on police duty, wife Priya decides to cheat on him with her tinder date Varun. But Priya is not the only one cheating.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: With her husband at the door, wife Priya struggles to hide her lover Varun’s dead body. Little does she know that her husband has more to hide than her.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As Priya and Jayesh conspire to get rid of Malti’s body, Jayesh struggles to hide his illicit relationship with her. What he doesn’t know is that Priya is hiding a lot as well.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As Priya and Jayesh come to terms with each other’s cheating ways and begin to work on their troubled relationship, there is trouble waiting for them outside their door. And inside too.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Malti’s body goes missing. If Priya and Jayesh thought that was trouble enough, they are wrong. Disgruntled Hawaldar Achcheylal Mishra is waiting outside.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Achcheylal knows about the shenanigans Priya and Jayesh have been up to. The only way to shut Achcheylal’s mouth is to kill him. Can husband and wife do it? Can they kill a man in cold blood to save themselves?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Malti returns to the Roy household. And she wants to stay, as Jayesh’s wife else she will rat the couple out to the cops. Will Priya trade her husband for her freedom?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Dreaded gangster Abbas comes visiting the Roy household as the true faces of all characters slow but surely get revealed.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: It’s Priya and Jayesh versus Abbas, the most dreaded gangster in town. They have to set aside their differences if they have any hope of overcoming this obstacle. Can they do it?
